name: DigitalBridge

source.quote: With a heritage of more than 30 years investing in and operating businesses across the digital ecosystem, including cell towers, data centers, fiber, small cells, and edge infrastructure, DigitalBridge manages $108 billion of infrastructure assets on behalf of its limited partners and shareholders.

description: Digital infrastructure investment manager (data centers, towers, fiber), owned by SoftBank Group since September 2026.
explain: DigitalBridge's funds took data center operator Switch private in an $11 billion deal; SoftBank bought the firm in 2026 to get a ready-made data center investing platform.
